exposure: Severe and refractory hypercalcemia associated with subcutaneous fat necrosis (SCFN)
cohort: A single newborn presenting with severe hypercalcemia refractory to standard treatment, secondary to subcutaneous fat necrosis.
finding: A single dose of neridronic acid was safe and effective in managing severe hypercalcemia unresponsive to conventional therapy without hypocalcemic rebounds in a newborn with subcutaneous fat necrosis.
